name: Hartford's Camp Courant
description_short: A free summer day camp, 8:30am-3:30pm, for children ages 5-12 who live in Hartford or East Hartford, at a campsite in Farmington. Hartford campers pay only a $125 non-refundable application fee; East Hartford campers pay $200 a week. Buses from Hartford stops, free breakfast and lunch, a full-time nurse, swimming, arts, nature, STEM, music and sports.
special_needs_notes: A full-time nurse is on staff. In an emergency, campers go to the UConn Health Center, two minutes away.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming and aquatics program teaches water safety and basic strokes; the camp publishes an Aquatics Safety Guide. Campers bring a bathing suit and towel, or the camp provides them.
